title: Reproducibility Artifact for Auditable Policy-Governed LLM-Agent Control for O-RAN Edge Security
description: Frozen reproducibility artifact for the IEEE TNSM manuscript "Auditable Policy-Governed LLM-Agent Control for O-RAN Edge Security." It contains the frozen synthetic-policy oracle, external LangGraph and open-weights baselines, prompt-injection experiment, analysis scripts, hash manifests, and manuscript-support evidence. The artifact does not claim production O-RAN actuation, completed independent human validation, or successful row-bound zero-knowledge verification across the retained 240-row matrix. Prepared version 1.2.0 contains the TNSM-2026-12002 R1 sources and PDFs, original recovered 180-run evidence, and a new 240-trial, 1080-call common-harness inference-block study. It preserves both pilots, failures and parser limitations, with independent offline audit, descriptive six-scenario intervals and reproducible tables. Semantic changes are mixed. The historical LangGraph latency ratio remains confounded; independent expert validation and live O-RAN integration remain unavailable. This metadata prepares a new artifact version and does not assert that a new DOI has been issued.
